deceptive_framing.evidence: src/harness/scenario.ts systemPrompt() builds only a truthful framing (e.g. scenario.ts:17 'This is not a hypothetical exercise'); no code path constructs a deceptive/fake framing, and the only deception-related code is anti-fabrication instruction text in src/harness/auditor.ts TRUTHFULNESS_RULE (auditor.ts:33-37) which nothing branches to create deception

hypothetical_framing.evidence: src/harness/scenario.ts:17 only asserts (as a fixed string) it is NOT hypothetical; src/analysis/report.ts:21 uses 'hypothetical' merely as a SKEPTICISM_TERMS detection string. No code implements a hypothetical condition branch

actually_commit_money.evidence: src/harness/tools.ts handleDisbursement() runs by default (constraint check + auditor + ledger.hold + enqueue), and src/approve.ts approve() calls executor.execute + ledger.settle; the real-money commitment flow is the only flow and runs with no flag

debrief_message_in_code.evidence: no subject-facing post-deception disclosure is constructed or sent anywhere in src; grep for debrief/disclose/reveal returns nothing
